Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.9, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.8:

- Vault sync status from the bottom bar
- Sync account in the bottom bar
- Encrypted personal vault sync on mobile
- SSH library updated to russh 0.65.4
- Send keys and a pinnable full-screen bar for remote desktops
- Remote and text console for server management sessions
- Vault sync status by device
- Mobile sync account pairing
- RD Gateway for RDP sessions
- Licence changed to GPL-3.0-or-later
- Shared vault key rotation
- WireGuard shown where it is used, and off when unused
- Seamless RemoteApp windows answer clicks
- Organization vaults
- Server management sessions (iDRAC, iLO, Redfish)
- Encrypted personal vault sync
- Desktop preference sync
- More shared folders and Kerberos login for RDP
- Reacher CM Sync account sign-in
- WireGuard tunnels for sessions
- One list per dropdown on iPhone and iPad
- File manager for RDP sessions
- RemoteApp
- macOS window buttons in line with the top bar

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
